units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 10:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. X, 10</cite> <he>אין הרשע מפיל בק׳ שלו וכ׳</he> Rashi to Ps. l. c. (ed. <he>בקולרים</he>, ed. Bub. <he>בקילורין</he>, corr. acc.) the wicked man involves in his own evil destiny none but wicked strong men like himself (ref. to <cite ref="Daniel 3:20">Dan. III, 20</cite>).—Pl. <he>קְלִירוֹסִין</he>, <he>קְלִירְסִין</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 58">Gen. R. s. 58</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="H00119"><he>חברון</he></cite> and <he>קרית ארבע</he>) <he>שהוא עולה בקרסין של וכ׳</he> (some ed. a. Matt. K. <he>בקרנסין</he>, Ar. <he>בקורנס׳</he>, ‘Rashi’ <he>בקינסרין</he>; corr. acc.) for Hebron came up in the lot of (was in turn assigned to) four owners, first to Judah &c. Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 2) <he>בשעה שהפלתי קלבסים וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קלסים</he>, read <he>קלירסים</he>) when I cast lots upon the nations to exile them &c. (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 24:6">Ez. XXIV, 6</cite> <cite ref="C00497"><he>גורל</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 363:1">Yalk. Ez. 363</cite> <he>קלווסי׳</he> (corr. acc.).
